revise_description: The objective is changed from maximizing only terminal wealth to maximizing net profit at the end of Year 3 after applying a liquidity reserve penalty. The company now values ending wealth but requires at least 80,000 yuan to remain uninvested at the beginning of Year 3; any shortfall incurs a penalty in the objective.
